events.name: Nag Panchami
events.description: Citywide snake-worship festival; the historic Nag Kuan well-temple in Kabir Chaura hosts Varanasi's best-known Nag Panchami mela.

events.name: Krishna Janmashtami (Smarta / citywide observance)
events.date_note: Most Varanasi temples, including Kashi Vishwanath, follow the Smarta tradition (Ashtami tithi at midnight) and mark Janmashtami on Sep 4, 2026. ISKCON Varanasi and other Vaishnav temples follow sunrise Rohini-Nakshatra alignment and observe it a day later, on Sep 5 — see the separate ISKCON entry.
events.description: Birth anniversary of Lord Krishna, marked with special midnight puja and decorations at temples across the city.

events.name: Krishna Janmashtami (ISKCON / Vaishnav tradition)
events.date_note: ISKCON and other Vaishnav-tradition temples observe Janmashtami a day after most Varanasi temples (see the Sep 4 citywide entry) because they wait for Rohini Nakshatra to align with Ashtami tithi at sunrise rather than midnight.

location.name: ISKCON Varanasi (Sri Sri Radha Gopal Ji Temple, Durgakund Road)

events.description: Grand Vaishnav-tradition Janmashtami celebration with midnight abhishek and cultural programs at ISKCON Varanasi.

events.name: Hartalika Teej
events.description: Women's fasting festival honoring Goddess Parvati; large numbers of devotees visit Kashi Vishwanath and Shiva temples across the city for special puja.

events.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
events.date_note: Marks the start of the 10-day Ganesh festival. Celebrations happen via community pandals across the old city rather than at one fixed venue; Godowlia is used here as a representative central-city pin, not a single official site.
events.description: Start of the 10-day Ganesh festival, marked increasingly by community pandals and processions across Varanasi's old city.
